messages:
Ava Patel: ok team quick question — who has the funniest office/remote-work moment to share? :joy:
Liam Chen: I once joined a customer call and my toddler screamed 'DINNER!' live on the mic, and the customer asked for the recipe lol
Noah Thompson: haha, mine is less cute — accidentally ran a load-test against prod because I forgot the -staging flag. learned about alerting the hard way :grimacing:
Sophie Martin: I had a plant fall off my shelf mid-demo and it sprayed soil everywhere, paused the demo for 3 minutes to perform a triage of pot + camera angle :rofl:
Ava Patel: @Liam Chen that toddler story wins so far. deploy-bot: nightly-deploy succeeded (green) :white_check_mark:
Liam Chen: true but I had a Zoom background stuck on 'beach' during an all-hands and someone took a screenshot that became my nickname for 2 months :sweat_smile:
Noah Thompson: once my cat walked over keyboard and submitted a PR with just ';;;' as the title. reviewer comment: "This is art"
Sophie Martin: that is peak GitHub behavior
Ava Patel: we should do a silly awards channel for these. best story wins a virtual coffee voucher :coffee:
Liam Chen: vote for toddler dinner story! :raised_hands:
Noah Thompson: vote cat-PR for most likely to break CI :cat2:
Sophie Martin: can someone make a quick poll? I will donate my voucher if I lose :wink:
Ava Patel: I'll make the poll. tl;dr: share a 1-line embarrassing/adorable remote-work moment. keep it short, keep it comfy.
